parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use correct $\cos(A-B)$ formula to obtain an equation in $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$. [B1] Guidance: $\cos\theta\cos60^\circ+\sin\theta\sin60^\circ=3\sin\theta$.
Use the trigonometric formula and substitute values for $\cos60^\circ$ and $\sin60^\circ$ to obtain an equation in $\tan\theta$ (or $\cos\theta$ or $\sin\theta$). [M1] Guidance: allow $1/2$ and $\sqrt3/2$ interchanged. Accepted equations are $\frac12+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\tan\theta=3\tan\theta$; $\frac14\cos^2\theta=(3-\frac{\sqrt3}{2})(3-\frac{\sqrt3}{2})(1-\cos^2\theta)$; or $\frac14(1-\sin^2\theta)=(3-\frac{\sqrt3}{2})(3-\frac{\sqrt3}{2})\sin^2\theta$.
Obtain $\tan\theta=1/(6-\sqrt3)$ or $\tan\theta=(6+\sqrt3)/33$ or $0.2343$; or $\cos\theta=(3\sqrt3/2)/\sqrt{10-3\sqrt3}$ or $0.9736$; or $\sin\theta=(1/2)/\sqrt{10-3\sqrt3}$ or $0.2281$. [A1 OE]
Obtain $\theta=13.2^\circ$. [A1] Guidance: may be more accurate; allow rounding from $13.1867^\circ$.
Obtain $\theta=193.2^\circ$ and no others in the interval. [A1 FT] Guidance: may be more accurate; FT is on the previous value of $\theta$ and requires M1. If $\theta$ is negative, e.g. $-13.2^\circ$, then $-13.2+180=166.8$ is A0 but $-13.2+360=346.8$ is A1 FT. Ignore answers outside the interval. Treat radians as a misread; $0.23015,3.3717$.
Alternative $R\cos(\theta\pm\alpha)$ method: use the correct $\cos(A-B)$ formula to obtain $\cos\theta\cos60^\circ+\sin\theta\sin60^\circ=3\sin\theta$. [B1] Use a correct method for $\tan\alpha$ from $p\cos\theta+q\sin\theta=0$, with $\tan\alpha=\pm q/p$. [M1] Obtain $\alpha=76.8^\circ$ or $1.34$ radians; the value may be more accurate. [A1] Obtain $\theta=13.2^\circ$; the value may be more accurate and may round from $13.1867^\circ$. [A1] Obtain $\theta=193.2^\circ$ and no others; the value may be more accurate, and FT is on the previous value of $\theta$ and requires M1. [A1 FT] If $\theta$ is negative, e.g. $-13.2^\circ$, then $-13.2+180=166.8$ is A0 but $-13.2+360=346.8$ is A1 FT. Ignore answers outside the interval. Treat radians as a misread; $0.23015,3.3717$. Total: 5.
